About Ledonie

The Little Witch

A Message From Ledonie

I've always known that there was more to this world than what we see. From a young age, I felt the pull of the stars and the presence of something beyond the veil. Growing up in Perth, I began studying astrology in my teens and discovered a language that felt like coming home.

My journey as a medium came later — a gift I came to understand and embrace through my own spiritual practice. Connecting with loved ones who've crossed over, bringing through messages of love and reassurance — this is the work that fills my soul.

The tarot has been my companion through it all. Those 78 cards hold a universe of wisdom, and every reading is a conversation between the seen and unseen, between you and your highest self.

Whether you're seeking guidance on love, career, family, or your spiritual path — I believe the stars, the cards, and spirit have something to say. Let me help you hear it.

Specialties

  • ☽ Natal Chart Readings — understanding your cosmic blueprint
  • 👁 Mediumship — connecting with loved ones who've crossed
  • 🃏 Tarot & Oracle Readings — guidance from the cards
  • ★ Transit Reports — what the heavens are doing for you right now
  • 🌙 Weekly & Monthly Horoscopes

My Approach

Compassion First

Every reading is held in a safe, non-judgmental space. Your story, your struggles, your joy — it's all welcome here.

No Sugar-Coating

The stars don't lie, and neither will I. What the cards and the cosmos show me, I share with honesty and care.

Empowerment Over Dependency

My goal is to help you find your own inner wisdom — not to keep you coming back for answers you already have.
